summary: Underneath it, you swing between a strong will and deep reserves of energy and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you go after what you want and don't back down; other days you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver. The work is holding both without picking a side.
body: Underneath it, you swing between a strong will and deep reserves of energy and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you go after what you want and don't back down; other days you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver. The work is holding both without picking a side. Big drive and ambition; focus is what turns it into results rather than waste.
gift: At your best: you go after what you want and don't back down, and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
shadow: The trap: your temper gets ahead of you, you sit on it, then blow up at whoever is closest, or you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver.
integration: Let drive and anger and growth and belief cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Big drive and ambition; focus is what turns it into results rather than waste.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you go after what you want and you reach, grow, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Your temper gets ahead of you
Let the reflex make the decision
